purpose: Discover a concrete allocation-versus-value discrepancy from existing matched models; no new idea or L5 acceptance gate.
scope: Posthoc descriptive validation1024 CPU-rebuilt frozen features, fixed formal fresh5 seed29 selected heads; not original GPU-cache reproduction or independent confirmation.
scientific_question: When Q and a control disagree, does swapping that control attention into the fixed Q value/decoder correct Q errors, and how often does the reverse swap harm it? Retain both directions and all four correctness cells.
alternatives: Attention allocation is locally actionable at fixed recipient utilities.
Value/decoder coadaptation or unavailable utility information limits swaps; attention differences alone do not explain model errors.
estimands: All1024 cohort metrics, correctness cells, corrected/harmed counts, CE changes and attention L1; four controls all retained.

Every original and hybrid estimand uses identical float64 alpha*utility reduction; Torch fp32 native metrics, argmax disagreements and margins reported separately. No-op has identical path, including near ties.
Symmetric logit allocation/value Shapley identity as a known consistency tool, not a new theorem or total-gain mediation.
head_selection: Original strictly largest validation Macro-F1, earliest tie; no checkpoint or seed selection using this diagnostic.
trace_selection: Posthoc descriptive matched contrast set: for each of all four controls and each of Q/control correctness01,10,11,00, choose lexicographically smallest stable sample ID if nonempty; union <=16; same cases all five models. Never confirmation.
private_outputs: Frozen-feature sample-trace.v2 package including full detached head values, source-linked stages, pinned checkpoint/input identities, arbitrary-coordinate reader and fresh replay audit. External encoder/tokenization/training outside declared boundary; no reconstructed trajectory.
lifecycle: Exact clean owner source -> bounded worker bundle -> exact temporary scheduler transaction in queue_submit.py -> one attempt; unknown retains reservation; restore exact prior owner/worker config bytes only after terminal/quiescent proof. No automatic retry, private archive or deletion.

launch.source_revision: Resolved clean commit of exact frozen source files, bound into deployment, scheduler and RUN_COMPLETE verification.
launch.placement: Existing authorized CPU node; refresh all due fleet health before allocation; no provisioning, node-capacity changes or platform lifecycle operations.

recovery: Restart-from-pinned-inputs only after termination; no resumable training. Completed diagnostic caches regenerate from durable formal selected heads and fixed-cache recipe, not new COS copies.

restoration.engine: Existing version-pinned selected member engine, source unchanged.
restoration.route: Owner public COS, same pinned VersionId. No internal claim, new purchase or independent-restore certification.
restoration.budget: Within previously reviewed conservative selected-object 1GiB ceiling; this operation hard-caps one object/4SDK multiplier. Cached exact object reuse makes new GET unnecessary.

stop: Any checkpoint/cache/source/role mismatch stops; no substitution.
Any trace or arithmetic validation failure stops result acceptance.
Results are descriptive with no positive-gain threshold; negative or null actionability is retained.
Changed model would need new theory/empirical support and collaborator-owned formal validation; no old L4 inheritance.
